edits.new_string:
local coins={}
local function removeCoin(coin)
 local state=coins[coin]
 if state then state.connection:Disconnect() coins[coin]=nil end
end
local function addCoin(coin)
 if not coin:IsA("BasePart") or coin.Parent~=folder or coins[coin] then return end
 local state={rest=coin:GetAttribute("RestCFrame")}
 state.connection=coin:GetAttributeChangedSignal("RestCFrame"):Connect(function()
  state.rest=coin:GetAttribute("RestCFrame")
 end)
 coins[coin]=state
end
local added=folder.ChildAdded:Connect(addCoin)
local removed=folder.ChildRemoved:Connect(removeCoin)
for _,coin in folder:GetChildren() do addCoin(coin) end
local render=Run.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
 local time=workspace:GetServerTimeNow() local root=player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
 if not root then return end
 for coin,state in coins do
  local rest=state.rest
  if rest and coin.Parent==folder and (root.Position-rest.Position).Magnitude<180 then
   coin.CFrame=rest*CFrame.new(0,math.sin(time*2.4+rest.Position.X*.37+rest.Position.Z*.21)*.55,0)*CFrame.Angles(0,time*1.2,0)
  end
 end
end)
script.Destroying:Connect(function()
 render:Disconnect() added:Disconnect() removed:Disconnect()
 for coin in coins do removeCoin(coin) end
end)
